dct_description_sm:
Contains the boundary of the Town of Caledon and the Cities of Brampton and Mississauga, the three of which collectively constitute the Region of Peel. The Region of Peel has regional municipal jurisdiction within, and only within, the larger boundary; individual municipalities have jurisdiction within, and only within, their respective boundaries.

There is a division of powers and responsibilities between these 3 municipalities, referred to by the Province as "lower tier municipalities", and the Region of Peel (referred to by the Province as an "upper tier municipality").

A recent update to the data includes new land added along Lake Ontario near the boundary with Toronto.
